audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart (Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn) and with the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[1] says 'He still owns the short trade' while the chart rendered Skill; whys[2] says 'lets you trade back evenly' while the chart rendered Ornn; whys[4] says 'R's double knock-up wins the all-in outright' while the chart rendered Pantheon. All three whys already agreed with the packet.
audit.corrected: Row 1 Skill -> Pantheon (3/10), row 2 Ornn -> Skill (5/10), row 4 Pantheon -> Ornn (6/10), in BOTH layers as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was handed to Pantheon in the chart and breakdown.spikes never named Grand Starfall or gave a cooldown.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s — the longest cooldown in either kit — at 5500 range. It is a map-pressure tool, not a duel-winner, so level 6 belongs to Ornn (Call of the Forge God, 140s, double knockup) while Grand Starfall is what threatens the rest of the map.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Grand Starfall at 6 with 180s and state that Pantheon falls off after first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said 'his passive blocks your autos' in whys[1], early, mid and wants.foe[1]. Mortal Will does no blocking at all — Riot's text is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The blocking ability is Aegis Assault (E): 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front'.
audit.why: This sends the player after the wrong thing. Believing a passive eats their autos, they stop auto-attacking; the truth is that Aegis Assault is a CHANNEL on 22/21/20/19/18s, it only covers the FRONT, and any CC cancels it — so Searing Charge's knockup or Call of the Forge God ends it outright, and damage from behind lands anyway. That interaction was flagged as missing and is the single most valuable line in this matchup. Also unnamed: Shield Vault is a 600-range dash, stun AND auto-attack reset on 13/12/11/10/9s (its wind-up is the burst tell), and Comet Spear is 575 range on 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will restated as spell empowerment; the auto-block re-attributed to Aegis Assault with its front-only condition, 22s cooldown and the channel-cancel; Shield Vault given its 600 range, 13s and reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried 'His all-in start. Brittle-tank it.' with no numbers and no mention of the 22s channel.
audit.why: Aegis Assault at 22s is his longest lane cooldown by a wide margin — that is the window to commit, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now gives Shield Vault 600/13s, Aegis Assault 22s with the cancel, and Grand Starfall 180s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: The don't titled 'Fight his early even' carried text about terrain lines instead of explaining why his levels 1-2 are unbeatable.
audit.corrected: Each rule now carries its own mechanic: the channel cancel, and conceding CS at Shield Vault range.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 belong to Pantheon — his W is a point-click stun he chains into an empowered Q spear, and his passive blocks your autos, so you have no shield and no combo to fight back. Don't contest CS inside his stun range; eat a little poke and farm with the tip of your Q. The moment you hit 3 and get W (Bellows Breath), the lane changes: it's unstoppable, so his stun can't interrupt it, and the shield plus percent-HP exhale let you trade back through Brittle.

notes: The recurring error was the same class as the mirror's: an ability's effect on the wrong slot. 'His passive blocks your autos' appeared in four strings — Mortal Will only empowers his next spell; the block is Aegis Assault (E), it covers the FRONT only, it is a channel that any CC cancels, and it sits on 22s at rank 1. Ornn's E knockup is a hard cancel on it, which is the strongest single line available in this matchup and had never reached the page. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether damage from behind fully bypasses Aegis Assault in practice (Riot says 'from the front' but gives no arc), whether Volcanic Rupture's grounding denies Shield Vault's dash or Grand Starfall's landing (grounding is a derived flag, absent from Riot's Volcanic Rupture text), and whether Shield Vault can target through a magma pillar.
